subject: MCP surface: remove git_status, fold git_init into branch_task
description: In /Users/imyu/Desktop/cloude/orchestrator/lib/mcp-core.js: a tool audit (2026-06-10) found git_init and git_status have zero references outside their definitions. Remove the git_status MCP tool. Remove git_init as a standalone tool and make branch_task auto-initialize the repo (call the same /git/init daemon endpoint internally when the target repo isn't a git repo yet) so the prerequisite is implicit. Keep the daemon HTTP endpoints themselves if other code calls them — this is an MCP tool-surface change, not an endpoint removal. Update README.md tool list and any skills/ references. Verify with test/ suite if present. Note: if a PreToolUse gate blocks direct edits to orchestrator source, write to /tmp and cp into place.
